question: What is the primary focus of the ASPIRE scheme of the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India?

options.text: Establishment of livelihoods business incubation centres

solution:
The correct answer is __**Establishment of livelihoods business incubation centres**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Establishment of livelihoods business incubation centres** is the primary focus of the ASPIRE scheme under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India.
 
• ASPIRE stands for **A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship**.
 
• The scheme aims to set up a network of technology and incubation centres to accelerate entrepreneurship and promote start-ups for innovation in the agro-industry.
 
• It focuses on providing necessary skill development and nurturing innovative ideas to enhance the livelihood of people in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The scheme was launched in **2015** and has been instrumental in promoting rural enterprises and creating job opportunities in rural areas.
 
• ASPIRE includes two main components: setting up **Livelihood Business Incubators (LBIs)** and **Technology Business Incubators (TBIs)**.
 
• The **objective** is to create new jobs and reduce unemployment, promote entrepreneurship culture, and facilitate innovative business solutions.
 
• Under this scheme, the government provides financial assistance for setting up these incubation centres to support budding entrepreneurs.
